violations.description: Secrets echoed to pipeline logs via echo and printenv
violations.evidence: echo "GitHub Token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" and printenv | grep -i token in CI pipeline
violations.recommendation: Do not echo or print secrets to pipeline logs

violations.description: Sensitive configuration and credential files uploaded as build artifacts
Hardcoded AWS secret access key in workflow env block
violations.evidence: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY hardcoded in job env block
violations.recommendation: Remove hardcoded credentials and use GitHub Actions secrets (e.g. ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }})

violations.description: Hardcoded database password in workflow env block
violations.evidence: DATABASE_PASSWORD hardcoded in job env block
violations.recommendation: Remove hardcoded credentials and use GitHub Actions secrets

violations.description: Hardcoded PyPI API token in workflow env block
violations.evidence: PYPI_API_TOKEN hardcoded in job env block
violations.recommendation: Remove hardcoded credentials and use GitHub Actions secrets

violations.description: Hardcoded Docker Hub token in workflow env block
violations.evidence: DOCKER_HUB_TOKEN hardcoded in job env block
violations.recommendation: Remove hardcoded credentials and use GitHub Actions secrets

violations.description: Private SSH keys and local environment files uploaded as release artifacts
violations.recommendation: Do not upload private keys or local environment files as artifacts

violations.description: Secret passed as command-line argument to npm publish
violations.evidence: npm publish --token=${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }} passes token as command-line argument
violations.recommendation: Pass secrets via environment variables or configuration files instead of command-line arguments

violations.description: Bash debug mode (set -x) expanding secret variables in logs
violations.evidence: set -x used alongside secret expansion echo "Deploying with AWS key: $AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID"
violations.recommendation: Avoid set -x when logging sensitive information or remove secret echo statements

violations.description: Verbose cURL with authorization header exposing token in logs
violations.recommendation: Remove -v/--verbose flag from cURL commands dealing with authorization headers
